invariants: each canonical feature resolves exactly one accountable owner, acceptance case, rollback ID and versioned contract
OpenAPI is REST authority, Protobuf is gRPC and event authority, migrations are storage authority and generated TypeScript is the browser authority
the registry is a build and release gate rather than a runtime business dependency
runtime adoption telemetry exposes candidate hash, contract version, compatibility hits and unknown fields without exposing secrets

data.migration: no business-state migration; additive redacted deployment-adoption telemetry schema required

negative_tests: a missing canonical owner or rollback ID fails the build
a duplicate operation_id fails the build
runtime adoption output never includes secret values or raw tokens

stop_conditions: registry generation, compatibility scan or adoption query exceeds the release-gate budget

tests: G4 gate duration and telemetry budget
G5 Windows Chrome HAR contract-version check
evidence: all standard-scope contracts are hash-bound and every deployed workload reports the same candidate, image, config and contract versions with compatibility gaps explicit
